description: This pie chart visually compares two categories: “Reduction” and “Efficient deployment.” The chart is divided into two slices, with the “Reduction” category occupying the larger portion, colored orange, and labeled with the value “60.9s (69.92%)”, indicating it represents 69.92% of the total. The smaller slice, colored blue and labeled “Efficient deployment,” contains the value “26.2s” and represents the remaining 30.08% (implied by subtraction from 100%). The blue slice is visually separated from the rest of the chart by being slightly exploded or offset outward. There is no legend, and no percentage labels are shown inside the orange slice. The slices appear to be ordered with the largest segment at the bottom left and the smaller segment at the top right.
